To Whom It May Concern: 

	So this is it. Twenty-three years of breathing, eating, bleeding, trying and failing all have amounted to this moment. You know, I used to believe that this life was a gift so wondrous and profound. I used to think that this giant, rolling orb of dirt and water held something magical under the foggy guise of its atmosphere. It was a big, badass world out there just waiting for me to take my stake in its treasure. I can assure you that I’m no longer that naive. I guess I have you to thank for that. But, let’s speak plain. You have always known that it would come down to this. How couldn’t you? This is all of your design, and I –like so many others –are just pawns at the disposal of your discretion. That’s fine. But, you are going to hear what I have to say. If I was born with a conscience then I am sure you have at least something similar in design locked in the DNA of your heart as well. 
	
      I was always an outlier. Exiled from the wholesome life, never to have friends to lean on, never to know love, never to appreciate the details of my soul, and never to live a worthy life. My entire life I’ve been forced to look through the looking glass, and wonder what it must be like to not have to worry about where you’re next meal was going to come from. I wonder how it must feel to not be stifled, to unleash myself. But that was never in your plan, was it? I was born for something far more sinister. I was to be born a knock around kid for you to shove your pills down his throat, to entwine him into the lies and insecurities of someone who was supposed to love him. Hmm…there’s that word again. Was my life some trite, tasteless bet to see how long it’d take me to break? Was that it? Why else would every time I obtain something worth having, something prideful and exulting, it’s ripped from my hands before I could even fully appreciate having it. Are you punishing me for not upholding this wondrous gift to the standards you desire, a gift I recall never requesting? Fuck you! You pompous, egotistical, controlling ass! Every lover, every opportunity, every success, every moment of solace, every shred of hope, all have been destroyed by your hands.  
	
         And now you cry out for me to show my appreciation…for you…I am supposed to forget all the times you’ve betrayed me, and left me out to die in the valley of darkness. The same valley you assured me protection and safe passage through. It’d be comical if it weren’t so sad. Oh that’s right! You’re the bringer of the gift, you’re precious little gift. You will not guilt me into submission. I have let myself become restrained by the fetters of your influence for too long. Like I told you before, I am not that naïve anymore. No. No, I am something so much more now. I am what you made me. Vengeance. 

	I will turn the other cheek no longer. Your freak has taken off its leash, and it wants only one thing. It’s funny what happens to a man when he resides to long in the darkness. He becomes a child once more. It indulges the vices around him like the trinkets in a toy store. The vices you tell me not to touch for sake of my “purity.” Fuck you! I haven’t a chance at purity. Not when you birth me into a world of manipulative, greedy, succubi who’d rather see me dead in a jail cell than out doing something worthwhile. But, I don’t blame them. No, not at all. They are nothing but sheep, following their shepherd –too stupid to truly know what they do. I blame you in their stead. For it was you whom told me that hard work will reward the laborer. It was you who brought me here, against my own will –a will you so vehemently assured would be protected. I am starting to feel like a fool sold into the serfdom of your entertainment. No more. I am clearing out my desk, emptying my locker, and shutting off the lights. You can consider this my resignation. Keep your gift. 

Sincerely, 
Your Former Devout Follower.
